title: Chilli basil squid
summary: Chilli basil squid is a thai dinner built around squid rings and fresh basil, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Slice squid rings and fresh basil before the pan is hot. Chilli basil squid is a fast cook, so have the sauce measured too.
steps.tip: A crowded wok steams. Cook the protein in two batches if the pan looks full.

steps.instruction: If the dish includes a grain or noodles, start them now in salted water so they are ready when the stir-fry is.
Heat the oil until it shimmers and fry squid rings until just cooked. Scoop it onto a plate.

Fry the garlic and ginger, add fresh basil and fresh red chillies, return squid rings, and toss with the sauce for a minute. Taste Chilli basil squid before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.

image.alt: Chilli basil squid served for dinner
